items.source: Release references to the BeanFactory and BeanWiringInfoResolver when the container is destroyed.
items.translation: 销毁容器时，释放对 BeanFactory 和 BeanWiringInfoResolver 的引用。

items.source: Check that a BeanFactory has been set.
items.translation: 检查是否已设置 `BeanFactory`。

items.source: Subclasses may also need a custom metadata resolution strategy, in the BeanWiringInfoResolver interface. The default implementation looks for a bean with the same name as the fully-qualified class name. (This is the default name of the bean in a Spring XML file if the 'id' attribute is not used.)
items.translation: 子类可能还需要自定义元数据解析策略，位于BeanWiringInfoResolver接口中。默认实现会查找与完全限定类名相同的 Bean。（如果未使用'id'属性，这将是 Spring XML 文件中 Bean 的默认名称。）

items.source: The default implementation builds a ClassNameBeanWiringInfoResolver.
items.translation: 默认实现构建一个ClassNameBeanWiringInfoResolver。

items.source:
The default behavior is to look for a bean with the same name as the class.
As an alternative, consider using annotation-driven bean wiring.
items.translation: 默认行为是查找与类同名的 Bean。作为替代方案，请考虑使用基于注解的 Bean 装配。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this to provide custom configuration logic.
Typically called by an aspect, for all bean instances matched by a pointcut.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以提供自定义配置逻辑。通常由切面调用，针对所有与切入点匹配的 Bean 实例。

items.source: Set the BeanFactory in which this aspect must configure beans.
items.translation: 设置此切面必须配置 Bean 的BeanFactory。

items.source: Set the BeanWiringInfoResolver to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的BeanWiringInfoResolver。

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to configure (must not be null)
items.translation: beanInstance - 要配置的 Bean 实例（不能为 null）

items.source: Rob Harrop, Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Adrian Colyer

Create the default BeanWiringInfoResolver to be used if none was
specified explicitly.
items.translation: 创建默认的 BeanWiringInfoResolver，如果未显式指定则使用它。
`setBeanFactory` 接口 `BeanFactoryAware` 中
`afterPropertiesSet` 接口 `InitializingBean` 中
`destroy` 接口 `DisposableBean` 中

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory (never null). The bean can immediately call methods on the factory.
items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。
